content.title: Albemarle Leads S&P 500 As Lithium Becomes An AI Play
content.summary: Albemarle was a top-performing S&P 500 stock on Monday, after the chairman of Ganfeng Lithium Group, the world's largest lithium metal producer, forecast 30% or 40% growth in demand for the battery metal next year.  Ganfeng Chairman Li Liangbin predicted that the market price for lithium carbonate in China could surge to 150,000 yuan per metric ton, just over $21,000, or even as high as 200,000 yuan.  Reuters cited local media outlet Cailian for the report, which sparked a 9% jump in the lithium carbonate contract on the Guangzhou Futures Exchange to 95,200 yuan (or $13,400) per metric ton.
